editSummary: Seeded a REM sleep minutes biomarker page with wearable REM interpretation guidance, private metric bindings, protocol ranking, community-outcome placeholder, and source-backed measurement caveats.
rationale: REM sleep appears in wearable sleep dashboards and Murph sleep experiments, but it needs conservative, source-backed interpretation because PSG-defined REM is biologically real while consumer REM-stage estimates are noisy.

editSummary: Added a publishable Blood Glucose biomarker page with diagnostic boundaries, monitoring/device guardrails, hypoglycemia safety language, protocol rankings, and source-backed claims.
rationale: Murph needs a glucose page that separates clinical diagnosis from personal tracking, surfaces method and timing context, and can read imported glucose samples in the private browser-vault biomarker trend card.

editSummary: Expanded Deep Sleep Minutes from a draft stub into a structured Health Commons biomarker page with wearable bindings, measurement guardrails, claims, protocol ranking, community-outcome placeholder, and source artifacts.
rationale: Make /biomarkers/deep-sleep-minutes publishable in apps/web while keeping consumer sleep-stage limitations and source-backed claim boundaries visible.

editSummary: Added the Blood Oxygen Saturation (SpO₂) biomarker page with browser-vault SpO₂ bindings, measurement caveats, protocol rankings, and source-backed interpretation boundaries.
rationale: SpO₂ is already imported from wearable providers and should have a Health Commons page that treats it as a respiratory and sleep safety-context signal rather than an optimization target.

editSummary: Added explicit SpO₂ evidence claims and clarified percentage-point delta copy in the biomarker trend card.
rationale: The initial SpO₂ landing cites the right sources but renders no evidence cards, and the trend delta copy can read like a relative percent instead of an absolute percentage-point change.

editSummary: Expanded the existing estimated VO2max biomarker into a publishable VO₂ Max page with measurement guidance, private browser-vault metric bindings, evidence-backed claims, protocol ranking, and new VO₂ max source artifacts.
rationale: The biomarker route already existed as biomarker:estimated-vo2max and is referenced by Norwegian 4x4 sources; enriching that page preserves existing graph links while making the biomarker available in apps/web with cautious lab-versus-wearable interpretation.

editSummary: Expanded the HRV / RMSSD biomarker from a thin sauna-related stub into a publishable Health Commons biomarker page with browser-vault bindings, measurement guidance, claims, protocol rankings, community-outcome placeholder, and a curated HRV evidence source set.
rationale: The web biomarker route only publishes pages with structured biomarker metadata, private metric bindings, protocol candidates, and community outcome data. HRV also needs explicit measurement guardrails because it is context-sensitive and commonly overinterpreted from consumer wearables.
